description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldDate class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldDateTime, providing methods for displaying date fields in lists and filtering by date ranges in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDate
classes.description: A widget class for handling date fields in list views and filters, extending SugarWidgetFieldDateTime.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Displays the list view for the date field, optionally using a column function if specified.

methods.name: queryFilterBefore
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for dates before a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterAfter
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for dates after a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_str
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for dates not equal to a specified date, including NULL values.

methods.name: queryFilterOn
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for dates equal to a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween_Dates
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for dates between two specified dates.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_yesterday
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for yesterday's date.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_today
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for today's date.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_tomorrow
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for tomorrow's date.

methods.name: queryMonth
methods.description: Helper method to filter records within a specific month.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current time adjusted for timezone and user context.
